fields.Name: T113 - Dashboard Share Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the openShareDialog gate (CanShare) and the dedicated dashboard-share-dialog component (user search, owner row, per-user permission checkboxes) — a bespoke sharing UI not covered by any generic form or the read-only agent share tools.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open Data Explorer, then the Dashboards section. Create or open a dashboard you own so you can view it, then in the view toolbar (top-right) click the Share button (a person-plus / share icon). A share dialog titled 'Share "<dashboard name>"' should open with a 'Add people by name or email...' search box, a 'People with access' section listing the Owner, and per-person permission toggles (view/edit/delete/share). Success is the share dialog rendering with these controls — you do NOT need to actually add a user or save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Share action is available in the dashboard view toolbar for an owned dashboard
Clicking it opens a share dialog with a people search input and a 'People with access' section showing the Owner
Permission toggle controls (view/edit/delete/share) and Save/Cancel buttons are visible in the dialog
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
